pick.headline: Earthquake devastates northern Iran
pick.summary: Shortly after midnight on June 21, 1990, an earthquake struck Gilan and Zanjan provinces in northern Iran, destroying towns such as Rudbar and Manjil and killing tens of thousands of people.
pick.significance: Iran accepted aid from many countries, including a small amount from the United States, the first since the break in relations in 1980.
pick.fbis: The Soviet Union Daily Report of June 21, 1990, carried Moscow TASS in English: tremors from a quake in Iran hit southern Azerbaijan early that day, damaging old buildings in Baku but hurting no one.
